name: Cook Family Farm
description: Cook Family Farm grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples in 621 Hudson Mill Road, GA. The farm is small, and its seasons run through spring, summer, autumn, and winter. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Mar – Jun in this growing zone.
